newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end higher on hectic stocks.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end higher on hectic stocks.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed sharply higher on Thursday with funds streaming out of the banking system into the recently red hot stock market, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 7.217 percent against Wednesday's 6.817 percent finish -- well above the central bank's target zone of 5.0-5.5 percent -- with 30-day commercial paper soaring to 7.00-7.25 percent against 6.75-7.00.
The stock market, despite closing lower for the first time in five sessions on Thursday, notched an all-time high turnover of T$251 billion.
Dealers said they expected the rates to stabilise on Friday, but saw little room for a significant downward correction.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 5.8350-8370 percent against 5.8470.
